answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by bonding each identity to collateral and linking equivocation evidence across identities: when k agents coordinate conflicting votes, correlated penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss. Thus, a swarm cannot hide behind cheap accounts; its knoll, reef, and pulse of apparent diversity become liabilities as escrowed stake depreciates asymmetrically.
